engineDecision.renderingConfiguration: project.godot advertises Godot 4.7 C# Forward Plus while the Windows export preset selects gl_compatibility; ISSUE-01 records this difference and does not change rendering mode.
engineDecision.decision: User decision on 2026-09-10: Godot .NET 4.7.2 is the official V2.5 implementation baseline. Keep the typed C# Core/Data/Simulation/Application/Presentation boundary and isolate engine calls. APIs supported by 4.7.2 may be used. A successful 4.7.2 compile/export is valid baseline technical evidence, never gameplay acceptance. Do not rewrite the project to GDScript blindly.

items.change: Add typed V2.5 records/loaders for profiles, species, regions, equipment, skills, quests, sync, encounters, unique powers and balance. Validate lowercase DefinitionId/AssetId and reject unknown IDs without a default Skeleton.
items.deletionRisk: Do not delete old config files until all GameDefinitions call sites migrate.
items.implementation: CanonicalV25Loader and typed registry now load the pinned physical bundle with strict nested-field/hash/cross-reference validation; profile skill projection is rank-filtered.

items.change: Implement explicit int64 overflow checks, decimal UID persistence, fixed-point units, round-half-up, RankFromLevel rejection for fractional/NaN/Infinity input, canonical CP and XP formulas, and deterministic RNG ownership.
items.deletionRisk: Old floor/clamp behavior is embedded in PlayerSystem and progression; migrate callers before removal.
items.implementation: V25FixedPoint, canonical CP/stat/rank/XP formulas, PCG32 streams, decimal UID allocator persistence and typed live runtime serialization are implemented; Density/Sync/Soul ownership and command-wide transaction IDs remain later work.

items.change: Keep Godot Arena._PhysicsProcess as the normally-60-Hz outer callback, then add a domain fixed-step coordinator that owns tick sequencing, phase order, RNG and cross-system transactions; keep menu pause from clearing InCombat.
items.deletionRisk: Existing frame-delta Update paths and direct system mutations can double-apply events.
items.implementation: SimulationClock owns whole 60 Hz steps; GameSession and V25CombatCoordinator prepare expiry/DoT before movement, then process intent, cast release and projectiles. Global command transaction/sequence ownership remains later.

items.change: Implement canonical WASD/Mouse/LMB/Space and modifier inputs, normalized movement, 300 ms/72 u swept dodge with 200 ms invulnerability and 1200 ms cooldown, action locks, and 640x360 pixel-snapped camera settings.
items.deletionRisk: Current attack action maps both Space and LMB; old save/load/devour shortcuts are presentation dependencies.
items.implementation: Canonical Player state carries Spirit/dodge; Arena maps WASD/Mouse/LMB/Space; swept 72-unit dodge, 200 ms invulnerability and 1200 ms cooldown are live. Menus and full action map remain later.

items.implementation: V25CombatCoordinator implements acceptance, 100 ms request buffer, windup/active/recovery, release-only hits, target revalidation, ground-point/direction, projectile sweep and hit identity.

items.change: Add Physical/Fire/Frost/Toxic/Arcane mitigation, armor cap, resistance and defense reduction, minimum shield absorption, immunity, wards and status effects with deterministic ticking.

items.implementation: V25DamageResolver, V25StatusStore and source-keyed V25ShieldStore implement mitigation, HP/shield absorption, status expiry/DoT, cleanse targeting, boss stun-to-stagger, timed swept knockback and boss immunity; hazard/mastery attribution remains later.

items.change: Add encounter identity, normal/elite/boss factors, add budgets, life UID/death state, player/ally kill credit, reward eligibility, and one receipt per encounter.

items.implementation: Monster life/encounter metadata, reward eligibility and defeat identity event fields are live; progression uses an in-memory duplicate guard. Persistent reward receipts and coin/item/Soul awards remain later.
